intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one independent, random, complex photorealistic render-test concept in the assigned glasshouse kinetic-sculpture maintenance lane, using the supplied portrait solely for facial and general appearance continuity rather than a biometric identity claim, while keeping the complete wardrobe visually inspectable and its topology undecided.

Photorealistic environmental editorial, vertical full-body frame inside a humid botanical glasshouse at blue hour. One unmistakably adult woman with long, dark, softly waved hair swept behind both shoulders follows the supplied portrait as a facial and general appearance reference. She calibrates a suspended kinetic sculpture: her right hand turns a side-mounted brass tension wheel while her left holds a compact optical tachometer low beside her thigh. Dichroic fins rotate above and behind her, casting physically plausible cyan, magenta, amber, and emerald caustics across condensation-beaded panes, leaves, and wet stone. A halted fin and a blurred arc of moving elements make the maintenance event legible. Keep the sculpture, tools, foliage, and reflections laterally separated from her silhouette. The complete outfit topology, neckline, both shoulders and sleeves, waist and closure or crotch and inseam region, legs, and hems must remain fully visible and readable in one vertical full-body frame. Her complete outfit remains unspecified for later wardrobe selection. She fills most of the frame height, with head and feet comfortably inside, natural perspective, crisp material detail, and believable skin and glass rendering.
